﻿🎬 CLIPPING GUIDELINES
Read before submitting. Clips that don't meet these requirements may be rejected. You may also join our chat: CLIPPING CHAT LINK HERE
📱 1. ACCOUNT REQUIREMENTS
Dedicated pages featuring only Michael Sartain content are required for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Exception: X (Twitter) allows your existing account.
Required Tags:
Platform
	Tag
	

	TikTok
	@michaelsartainpodcast
	Bio + video
	Instagram
	@michaelsartain
	Bio + video
	Facebook
	@michaelsartain
	Bio + video
	YouTube
	@michaelsartain
	Bio only
	X (Twitter)
	@sartainpodcast
	Bio + post
	

✅ 2. CONTENT GUIDELINES
Source: https://www.youtube.com/@MichaelSartain
Create original clips from Michael's podcasts, interviews, livestreams, or long-form videos - only choose content in the last 3 years. We prefer more recent content. 
Approved topics:
* Dating, relationships, and masculinity
* Confidence, status, and social circles
* Networking, social skills, and self-improvement
* Lifestyle
Do NOT clip:
* Pornography or adult content
* Politics, flat earth, money, wealth, or millionaires
* Dan Bilzerian or Michael's former relationship with Kylee
* Anything unrelated to Michael Sartain or Men of Action
Brand Rules:
* Michael must appear in at least 50% of the clip.
* No content attacking, demeaning, or negatively generalizing women.
* No rage-bait, inflammatory, misleading, or out-of-context edits.
* Content must align with the Men of Action brand.
🎥 3. VIDEO & EDITING REQUIREMENTS
* Format: 9:16 vertical
* Length: 20–180 seconds
* Captions: Burned-in captions required
* Hook: Strong opening within the first few seconds
* Editing: Optimize for retention, watch time, and shares
* B-roll: Optional
* Content age: Must be less than 3 years old
⭐ Newer content is more likely to be approved. Prioritize recent uploads.


Previously viral topics that are no longer accepted:
* "You live in a country..."
* "How much do you think the average guy in the US makes?"
Original edits only. No reposting, copying, or slightly modifying another creator's clips. Low-effort content will be rejected.
💰 4. PAYMENT & SUBMISSIONS
Your top audience must be from Tier 1 countries USA, UK
Minimum: 10,000 views per video within 5 days.
* Videos below 10K views after 5 days will be rejected.
* Reaching 10K views does not guarantee approval.
* All clips must follow campaign guidelines to qualify.
* HIGH BOT SCORES WILL BE REJECTED
** IF YOU DO NOT SEND ANALYTICS WE WILL REJECT YOU TEMPORARILY, we can reverse it when you send in your analytics if they meet the requirements. Content Rewards forces us to approve overdue content submissions so we cannot wait if you do not reply in time.
How to submit:
1. Post your original clip.
2. Submit it through the active Content Rewards campaign
3. Once eligible for payout, our team will DM you for a screen recording of your account analytics. You can send the recording ahead as well after you hit 10K views. 
Your screen recording must show:
* Video views and performance
* Audience demographics
* Top audience countries/locations
Send verification in the campaign chat.
Point of contact: @modJimmy
🚨 5. REJECTION & FRAUD POLICY
The following may result in immediate rejection:
* Fake, botted, purchased, or paid/boosted engagement
* Manipulated views, likes, comments, shares, or followers
* Missing, incomplete, or unverifiable analytics
* Fraudulent submissions or information
* Violations of content, editing, or brand guidelines
